titulo.estudio: Un profil personnel : Observer les formes
titulo.alumno: A personal profile: vocabulary and forms

intro: Understand a short presentation and distinguish personal details from preferences. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: Understand a short presentation and distinguish personal details from preferences. First look for names, days, places and figures: in notices and forms these are usually easy to find.
Point to note: possessives and verbs in the present help you follow who introduces whom and what they like. In this passage, «frère» means «brother».

frases.estudio: Il vit avec son frère et aime les films comiques.
frases.alumno: He lives with his brother and likes comedy films.

frases.estudio: Le samedi, il lit au café près de la gare.
frases.alumno: On Saturdays he reads in the café near the station.
